ariaLabel: Travel and interests field case close-up
header: FIELD CASE / LIFE OUTSIDE THE LAB

emptyState.title: Personal entries can be added here.
emptyState.copy: This case is reserved for confirmed places, photographs, activities, and observations from life outside the workstation.
emptyState.note: Replace prompts and layout pins only with details you want to share publicly.

travelMap.title: Places explored
travelMap.copy: A world map prepared for personal travel pins and short memories from days away. The visible pins are editable layout markers, not claims about specific destinations; replace them with confirmed places when ready.

photos.title: Frames from life outside work
photos.copy: A home for selected photographs from trips, days out, people, food, and small moments worth keeping. Add only images and captions you are comfortable sharing publicly.

archery.title: Archery
archery.copy: A placeholder for the personal side of archery: practice-day photographs, what makes the activity enjoyable, and any confirmed stories you choose to share. The model uses arrows and a protective finger tab to keep the scene in a clear sporting context.

targetSports.title: Target sports
targetSports.copy: A safety-first space for target-sport interests and practice-day memories, represented by target paper and safety cues rather than a weapon model. Add specific experiences only after confirming the details.
